definitions.explanation: Playing a supporting role in a film, play, or other performance. Most commonly seen in the context of awards and film credits.

examples.japanese: {助演|じょえん}{男優|だんゆう}{賞|しょう}を{受賞|じゅしょう}した。
examples.english: He won the Best Supporting Actor award.

examples.japanese: あの{女優|じょゆう}は{助演|じょえん}ながら{強|つよ}い{印象|いんしょう}を{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: That actress left a strong impression despite being in a supporting role.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{助演|じょえん}{女優|じょゆう}{賞|しょう}には{若手|わかて}の{実力派|じつりょくは}がノミネートされている。
examples.english: Talented young actresses have been nominated for this year's Best Supporting Actress award.

notes:
Compound of {助|じょ} (assist) + {演|えん} (perform). Refers to a supporting role in a film, play, or performance.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {助演|じょえん}{男優|だんゆう}{賞|しょう}: Best Supporting Actor award
- {助演|じょえん}{女優|じょゆう}{賞|しょう}: Best Supporting Actress award
- {助演|じょえん}{俳優|はいゆう}: supporting actor/actress

CONTRASTS:
- {主演|しゅえん}: starring role, lead role
- {助演|じょえん}: supporting role
- {端役|はやく}: minor role, bit part
- {脇役|わきやく}: supporting role (more colloquial synonym)

NOTE:
{脇役|わきやく} is more commonly used in everyday conversation to mean "supporting role," while {助演|じょえん} appears mainly in award names and formal film/theater terminology.
